title: 第十八章 清理门户！傅家叔侄彻底反目
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
她浑身一震，手机差点滑落，她慌忙用另一只手死死捂住嘴，不让自己哭出声。

    “妈妈好想你……他们都说你找不到了，不在了，我不信……妈妈一直等你回家……”

    “囡囡，不管你在哪儿，爸爸妈妈永远爱你……”

    那头的声音很温柔，但这一字一句，戳得人心口发疼。

    王伊若再也撑不住了，眼泪不停往外冒，浑身抖得厉害，不等对方说完，就慌乱地挂了电话。

    “怎么不跟她说说话？”姜无念轻声问。

    哽咽着拼命摇头，她艰难开口：“不说了……说了，我就舍不得走了……”

    姜无念不再多问，双手结印，口中低诵渡魂咒，一道道金光从她掌心飞出，轻轻裹住王伊若的魂体。

    “放下执念，早日投胎，或许来生还能和家人重逢。”

    随着话音落下，王伊若身上的阴气尽数散去，冤魂彻底脱离她的身体，露出原本的模样。

    她看起来和照片上一样，是个灿烂明媚的女孩，对着姜无念甜甜一笑，“谢谢大师。”

    魂体渐渐化作光点，消散在空气里。

    门口，傅烬川低头看着林砚发来的消息，冷哼一声，果然和他猜的一样，这件事确实和傅家有关。

    敢动不该动的心思，哪怕是血亲，也绝不能姑息。

    他不动声色地收起手机，抬眸看向姜无念，眼底戾气敛去，自己清理门户就够了，绝不能让无辜的人卷进家族纷争。

    魂体彻底消散的前一刻，一句微弱的声音飘进姜无念耳中：“大师，我发现好多和我一样的冤魂，都莫名其妙不见了……不知道去了哪里……”

    站在原地，姜无念眉头微蹙，陷入深思。

    深夜郊区，傅氏集团某处工厂仓库，灯光昏暗，四周堆满了货物，空气里飘散着铁锈的味道。

    傅烬川斜靠在椅子上，修长的指尖随意翻转着银色火机，火苗明灭间映出他眼底的寒意，身后林砚以及一众保镖安静伫立。

    “傅总，真不是我干的，您让林先生再查查清楚啊！”傅宏远跪在他面前，眼泪鼻涕糊了一脸，声音抖得不成样子。
content_en:
She was shocked and almost dropped her phone. She hurriedly covered her mouth with her other hand to prevent herself from crying.

    "Mom misses you so much... They all said you can't be found and are gone. I don't believe it... Mom has been waiting for you to come home..."

    "Nanny, no matter where you are, your parents will always love you..."

    The voice on the other end was very gentle, but each word made people's hearts ache.

    Wang Yiruo couldn't hold it in anymore, tears kept pouring out, and his whole body was shaking violently. He hung up the phone in panic before the other party finished speaking.

    "Why don't you talk to her?" Jiang Wu Nian asked softly.

    Choking and shaking her head desperately, she spoke with difficulty: "I won't say it anymore... If I say it, I won't be able to bear to leave..."

    Jiang Wu Nian asked no more questions, formed seals with her hands, and recited the soul-transferring mantra in her mouth. Rays of golden light flew out from her palms and gently enveloped Wang Yiruo's soul.

    "Let go of your obsessions and reincarnate as soon as possible. Maybe you can reunite with your family in the next life."

    As the words fell, all the Yin Qi on Wang Yiruo's body dissipated, and the innocent soul completely left her body, revealing her original appearance.

    She looked the same as in the photo, a bright and bright girl. She smiled sweetly at Jiang Wunian, "Thank you, master."

    The soul gradually turned into a point of light and dissipated in the air.

    At the door, Fu Jinchuan looked down at the message sent by Lin Yan and snorted coldly. As he guessed, this matter was indeed related to the Fu family.

    If you dare to have thoughts that you shouldn't have, even if you are a blood relative, you will never be tolerated.

    He put away his cell phone calmly and raised his eyes to look at Jiang Wu Nian. The anger in his eyes disappeared. It was enough to clean up the family by himself. He must not let innocent people get involved in family disputes.

    The moment before the soul completely dissipated, a weak voice floated into Jiang Wunian's ears: "Master, I found that many wronged souls like me have disappeared inexplicably... I don't know where they went..."

    Standing there, Jiang Wunian frowned slightly and fell into deep thought.

    Late at night in the suburbs, a factory warehouse of the Fu Group was dimly lit, surrounded by piles of goods, and the smell of rust wafted in the air.

    Fu Jinchuan leaned on the chair, flipping the silver lighter at will with his slender fingertips. The flames flashed and flickered, reflecting the chill in his eyes. Behind him, Lin Yan and a group of bodyguards stood quietly.

    "Mr. Fu, it really wasn't me. Please ask Mr. Lin to find out more!" Fu Hongyuan knelt in front of him, his face smeared with tears and snot, and his voice was shaking.
title_en: Chapter 18 Clean up the door! The uncle and nephew of the Fu family completely turned against each other
